title: progress-merge: gate fork reports when CI completes, and skip the first pass while build runs
body: Progress reports opened from a fork never land by themselves. Each one is gated once, when it opens, and never again. ## What happens now `progress-merge` gates a report twice: 1. On `pull_request_target`, when the report opens. On `workflow_run`, when CI completes. The resolver finds the pull request with `repos/$REPO/commits/$HEAD_SHA/pulls`, and the gate lands it.
